decision.comment:
Comparison stage is internally consistent and correctly computed. Verification:

(1) Arithmetic: accuracy_delta = 0.905571 − 0.840251 = 0.06532 ✓. baseline_met_or_exceeded = true is supported (0.905571 > 0.840251) ✓.

(2) Fairness controls: common_seed = 47 and common_split_fingerprint = 9afc9ed3…7505 are identical in both the baseline_report and the comparison_report, confirming a like-for-like evaluation on the same data partition ✓. Dataset is pathmnist in both ✓.

(3) Cross-artefact consistency: agentic_accuracy (0.905571) matches evaluation_report.accuracy and the confusion-matrix diagonal (6502/7180 = 0.905571) ✓. baseline_accuracy (0.840251) matches baseline_report.accuracy ✓.

(4) Baseline is a fixed tiny_cnn control (hidden=16, depth=2, 15 epochs, cosine schedule, seed 47) with a stated rationale of matching the agentic run's epoch budget — an appropriate conventional reference ✓.

(5) No deterministic findings are present. All prior stages (evaluation, abstention, reporting) passed with ok/continue. The OOD aggregate (0.776469) was verified in prior reviews as the arithmetic mean of per-severity max_softmax AUROCs ✓.

Advisory notes (non-blocking, carried forward from prior stages):
- Test coverage (0.6599) is ~14 pp below the target validation coverage (0.8001); the abstention threshold generalizes conservatively.
- OOD AUROC at σ=0.4 is near chance (0.558 max_softmax, 0.492 predictive_entropy); the corruption proxy has limited discriminative power at high severity.
- Per-class weaknesses (cancer-associated stroma recall 0.546; smooth muscle F1 0.735) may cause disproportionate abstention; stratified analysis recommended downstream.
- Prior-art quotes for ghostnet_vgg_robustness and temp_scaling_calibration extend beyond truncated source text; verify against full papers before further design decisions.
- llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8; exact LLM weights not pinned (auxiliary, non-blocking).

No issues warrant revision or stop. The comparison correctly establishes a 6.53 pp accuracy improvement over the fixed baseline under identical seed and split conditions.
